key_points: Salesforce announced a $50 billion share buyback program (if executed, would be sizable positive).
Kennon Green & Co. made a modest $5.54 million new investment in CRM.
Agentforce adoption is highlighted as a growing focus for the company.
Stock dipped 2.2% on Oct 5 and underperformed peers, reflecting short-term pressure.
Broader software sector faced selling pressure after Figma warned of rising AI costs.
